overview: White strikes at once with 4.e4 and, after 4...dxe4 5.Nxe4, plays for a lead in development, with Bd2 lines when Black checks on b4 (5...Bb4+ 6.Bd2 Qxd4 7.Bxb4 Qxe4+). Black can accept and then play ...Nf6 for a simple game or take the pawn on d4 and defend precisely. It is a sharp, theoretical line in which White gambles on an open centre.

white_ideas.idea: Open the centre with e4 and develop quickly with Nxe4, Bd3 and Qe2 or Nf3.
Offer the d4 pawn for activity after ...Bb4+ Bd2 and Bxb4.

black_ideas.idea: Accept with ...dxe4 and play ...Nf6 to exchange the e4 knight and reach a safe, equal game.
Check on b4 and take on d4 with the queen when it is safe, keeping the extra pawn if possible.

typical_structures.structure: Open centre after dxe4, with White's pieces developed and Black's c6-e6 pawns solid.

character.notes: Forcing play and an open centre with early checks and queen moves; a mistake can lose fast.

gambit.notes: In the 5...Bb4+ 6.Bd2 Qxd4 line Black can keep the d4 pawn; in the 5...Nf6 line the pawn is simply regained, so the gambit label is partial.

soundness.notes: Not clearly refuted but Black has easy equality with 5...Nf6; I judge White's compensation as enough to call it sound, with low certainty.

structure.notes: The centre opens after ...dxe4 and the pieces get open lines.

approach.notes: Seldom played by strong players; occasionally used for surprise.

level.notes: Forcing lines after 5...Bb4+ need to be known, though it is little played.

sublines_that_differ.name: 4...Bb4
sublines_that_differ.how: Black declines the pawn; no gambit, a quieter Semi-Slav-style position.

character.reason: Open centre and forcing checks and queen moves from move 5.

gambit.reason: White offers the d4 or e4 pawn for development, though Black can steer back to equality.

soundness.reason: Not clearly refuted, though Black has easy equality.

structure.reason: The centre opens after ...dxe4 and the pieces play on open lines.

level.reason: Some forcing lines must be known, but it is rarely met.

plans.reason: White gives a pawn for quick development and Black's queen is drawn out.
